data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 649.0m. The syndicate recognised favourable development on 2019 and prior years (reported as GBP 9.9m favourable) prior to executing a loss portfolio transfer in 2022 which transferred GBP 273.0m of liabilities to another syndicate. After these transactions the retained portfolio shows minimal net prior year movement (effectively flat) at the 2022 year end. The 2022 calendar year was impacted by major nat-cat events (eg. Hurricane Ian, Winter storm Elliott) which affected current-year claims rather than producing material prior-year reserve deterioration.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is complicated by loss portfolio transfers / RITC transactions in 2022 (2018/2019 LPT) and prior RITC (2017 & prior) which removed large gross liabilities; the explicit triangle shows effectively zero net PYD on the retained portfolio. Narrative quotes favourable development of GBP 9.9m prior to the LPT; the LPT itself removed GBP 273.0m of liabilities. Where narrative provides only net figures (after reinsurance) those were not used for gross PYD. RITC distortions mean triangle-based PYD should be treated cautiously.
